summary: Sets two render/state fields. Unconditionally writes a2 into this[21] (offset 0x54, texture/scale parameter). Then maps a3 in range 0-4 to an alpha-blend value written to this[22] (offset 0x58): 0->191, 1->127, 2->63, 3->0, 4->255. A default case (a3 outside 0-4) returns immediately, leaving this[22] unchanged. Always returns a3. The 0x58 selection uses a jump table (jpt_553000 at 0x0055303C).

operations.description: Unconditionally write a2 (texture/scale parameter) into this[21] at offset 0x54.
Switch on a3 selecting an alpha-blend value written to this[22] at offset 0x58 via jump table: 0->191, 1->127, 2->63, 3->0, 4->255.
Default case: a3 outside 0-4 returns immediately without writing this[22], preserving the previous blend value.

unresolved: Exact meaning of the five blend constants (191, 127, 63, 0, 255) is not independently proven; existing analysis labels this[22] an alpha-blend value but the caller (FontSurfaceLookupDispatch) semantics are not confirmed.
The jump table symbol jpt_553000 comes from existing analysis; the raw source does not name it.
